description: Get the STANDARD published Wilderness Times checklist as a ready-made PDF — the full, unedited list, free and with no signup. Available for all 12 activities. This is the standard list and does not reflect any customisation. A customised list is exported through share_checklist, whose link opens that list in the checklist builder with PDF, Excel, Google Sheets and print export.
name: get_checklist_pdf
title: Get a printable checklist PDF
